name: oss-ecosystems
description: Open-source Software Ecosystems: release, yank, deprecation and unpublish history, declared dependencies and dependency graphs as of a date, licence declarations as SPDX expressions, organisation-level publishers and reviewed repository links with Software Heritage provenance; advisories cited from Technology vulnerabilities.

query_examples.intent: Which releases of a package were yanked or deprecated on a date
query_examples.semantics: each release's state on the date as its registry stated it, reasons verbatim, deps.dev beside, knowledge cutoff and unobserved gaps stated

query_examples.intent: What did a release's dependency graph look like on a date
query_examples.semantics: declared-constraint resolution against releases published, acquired and available on the date, not an observed lockfile; unresolved edges with reasons; deps.dev's graph beside

query_examples.intent: Where did a package's declared licence change
query_examples.semantics: raw declarations and SPDX expressions per release with the list version cited; changes compared in normalised form; no licence interpretation
advisories cited from technology.vulnerabilities by revision; nothing copied; no risk verdict

exclusions: code-quality, security-posture, health, popularity or trust verdicts or scores
contributor or maintainer profiling: individual accounts, emails, commit authorship and activity
scraping of individual user or account pages
duplicated vulnerability records (advisories are cited from technology.vulnerabilities)
